abha_about1: ABDM (Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission) ialah sistem kesihatan digital nasional India. Nombor ABHA anda ialah ID kesihatan 14 digit yang membolehkan rekod mengikut anda di pelbagai hospital.
abha_about2: Sehat Copilot menyusun rekod anda dalam FHIR, format yang digunakan ABDM, supaya ia sedia dikongsi apabila anda memilihnya.
abha_demo: Demo: kotak sandaran ABDM simulasi, tiada data kesihatan sebenar diambil.
abha_imported: ABHA se {n} naye record aa gaye hain.
fhir_title: ABDM / FHIR ke liye export karein
fhir_note: Aapke profile aur record ka FHIR R4 bundle banata hai.
src_hint: Jis line se yeh padha gaya hai, use dekhne ke liye click karein.
unread_sub: Yeh line data jaisi lag rahi thin par theek se padhi nahi ja saki, isliye kuch bhi andaza nahi lagaya gaya. Agar zaroori ho toh inhein haath se jodein.
unit_skip: Doosri unit wale {n} nateeje compare nahi kiye gaye hain.
consent: Jab aap document upload karte hain, toh ise sirf padhne aur samjhane ke liye teesri party ki AI services (Google Gemini, aur backup ke liye Groq, NVIDIA ya OpenRouter) ko bheja jata hai. Hamara server kuch bhi save nahi karta. Record ishi phone par rehte hain aur aap jab chahein kisi bhi record ya saare data ko mita sakte hain.
privacy: Bharat ke Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 ke niyamon ke anusar banaya gaya hai. Yeh ek student prototype hai, koi certified ya jaancha hua service nahi hai. Kripya asli ki jagah sample ya aam documents ka istemal karein.
wipe_hint: Is phone par save sab kuch hata deta hai.
confirm_wipe: Kya aap is phone se saare record aur profile mitaana chahte hain? Isse yeh wapas nahi aayega.
err_network: Server se sampark nahi ho saka. Apna internet check karein aur dobara koshish karein.
err_type: Yeh file support nahi karti. Kripya photo, PDF ya text file use karein.
err_size: Yeh file 3 MB se badi hai. Kripya choti file chunein.
err_image: Yeh photo padhi nahi ja saki. Doosri photo try karein.
err_generic: Kuch galat ho gaya hai. Kripya dobara koshish karein.
